en.t: The match would not light no matter what he did.

units.source_text: 划了十根，十根都划不着。

en.t: He struck ten of them, and not one would light.

units.source_text: 以丢弃的火柴为轴，沙之波浪以秒针的速度移动。

en.t: With the discarded match as its axis, the waves of sand moved at the speed of a second hand.

units.source_text: 他以某个沙波浪为假定目标，等它正好滚到鞋边时，站了起来。

en.t: He chose one wave of sand as a provisional target, and when it rolled exactly to the edge of his shoe, he stood up.

units.source_text: 沙子从长裤的皱折里泼撒下来。

en.t: Sand spilled down from the folds of his trousers.

units.source_text: 他吐了一口唾沫，嘴里沙沙的，好难受。

en.t: He spat once; his mouth felt gritty, and it was terribly unpleasant.
